;Science and technology
*[[2018 in paleontology]]
**Researchers at the [[Imperial College London]] report the discovery of the ''[[Lingwulong]]'' [[genus]], a subgroup of [[Sauropoda|Sauropods]] that lived in [[China]] about [[Middle Jurassic|174 million years ago]], which is 15 million years earlier than any previously-known member of the group.
